DnsMetaModel.description: DNS metadata including name, annotations, labels, and tags.

name.description: Unique name for the DNS resource

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the DNS resource

DnsRecordModel.description:
One DNS record in a zone. `value` is a literal, or contains value tokens such as `${var:KEY}`, `${secret:KEY}`, `${feature:KEY}`, `${output:STEP.KEY}` or `${value:kind.name.path}`, resolved at build or deploy time.

`${output:STEP.KEY}` uses the output of an earlier execution step, for example to point an `A` record at the public IP Terraform produced. It is only accepted when this DNS document is a target of a provisioning step.

Rules:
- `priority` is only allowed on `MX` and `SRV` records.

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, NS, PTR, CAA

value.description: Record value: a literal, or a string containing value tokens (`${var:KEY}`, `${secret:KEY}`, `${feature:KEY}`, `${output:STEP.KEY}`, `${value:kind.name.path}`).

ttl.description: Record-level TTL override in seconds (>=1 if set)

priority.description: Priority, 1-65535. Only valid for MX and SRV records.

description.description: Description of the DNS record, optionally for provider

notes.description: Additional notes for the DNS record, not for provider

custom.description: Free-form values for your own scripts and Terraform code, passed with this record as `strata.dns.<name>.zones.<zone>.records[].custom`. Strata does not interpret them.

DnsSpecModel.description:
The DNS provider and the zones it manages.

Rules:
- Zone names must be unique within the document.

zones.description:
List of DNS zones (at least one required)

Rules:
- A record is a duplicate when its name, type and value are all the same. Records whose value contains a token are skipped in this comparison.
- A `CNAME` record's name cannot be shared with any other record in the zone, including another `CNAME`.

DnsZoneModel.description:
One DNS zone (a domain) and its records. Each zone is its own cloud resource, so its configuration, custom values and tags are set here; one document can hold several zones.

Rules:
- A record is a duplicate when its name, type and value are all the same. Records whose value contains a token are skipped in this comparison.
- A `CNAME` record's name cannot be shared with any other record in the zone, including another `CNAME`.

name.description: Domain name for this zone, e.g. 'huybrechts.xyz'

ttl.description: Default TTL in seconds for all records in this zone

records.description:
List of DNS records in this zone

Rules:
- `priority` is only allowed on `MX` and `SRV` records.

configuration.description: Free-form provisioner settings for this zone, passed to Terraform as `strata.dns.<name>.zones.<zone>.configuration`. Strata does not validate them.

custom.description: Free-form values for your own scripts and Terraform code, passed to Terraform as `strata.dns.<name>.zones.<zone>.custom`. Strata does not interpret them.

default_tags.description: Baseline cloud tags for this zone (for example `cost-center`, `environment`, `owner`), passed to Terraform as `strata.dns.<name>.zones.<zone>.default_tags`. Not the same as `meta.tags`, which is a free-form list for documentation. Strata does not limit the number of tags, so stay within your cloud provider's limit.

custom_tags.description: Additional cloud tags on top of `default_tags`, for one-off needs.

description:
DNS zones and their records, managed through a DNS provider such as `inwx`, `cloudflare` or `route53`. A workspace uses it by listing the document in `dns_zones`.

Rules:
- A zone domain should be declared in only one DNS document; declaring it twice gives a warning.

spec.description:
DNS specification (provider, zones)

Rules:
- Zone names must be unique within the document.
